caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent glass bowl rendered in shades of light green and teal. The bowl is shown in profile, centered on a plain, off-white background and enclosed within a fine rectangular border. The bowl's upper edge is circular, tapering downward to a narrower base, with two distinct decorative bands: the upper and lower sections feature a diamond-cut pattern, while the central band displays vertical fluted lines. The drawing utilizes shading and line work to suggest the reflective and translucent qualities of the glass material. There are no other objects or elements present in the composition. The artist's name, "John Dana," is handwritten in small letters in the lower left corner of the border.
title: Bowl
